items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. And they had another place up from Billy Berg's called The Hangover... But I knew he was at the time. And on Charlie Parker's off-night, he came in and sat in with us for the first time since he had been Billy Berg's... Billy Berg was quite a man. He really was a nightclub owner.

ctx.x: Yeah. And they had another place up from Billy Berg's called The Hangover, where the Dixieland players used to play...
